name: What are the penalties for DUI in California?

mainEntity.name: What are the penalties for DUI in California?

acceptedAnswer.text: DUI penalties in California include license suspension, fines, mandatory education, and possible jail time. Repeat offenses and high BAC results in harsher consequences and longer suspensions.
